stable_target: Phase 2 Stable Hermes for Platform Integration
purpose: Docs-only decision matrix for the minimal blocker set before a stable platform-facing Hermes baseline tag.
safety_rules: No raw platform reports, secrets, raw paths, raw DB rows, raw answers, or customer data.
This matrix does not create a stable tag.
This matrix does not authorize production rollout.
This matrix does not close full Phase 2 PRD or Roadmap metrics.

items.name: Platform single-turn plugin risk
items.recommended_action: Close through shared wording plus 0B Gateway hardening: Platform must treat Hermes as enterprise agent kernel and expose current compatibility-mode limitation honestly.
items.risk_if_deferred: Platform may integrate Hermes as a one-turn text endpoint and lose kernel/session authority.
items.notes: Runtime session fields may remain future only if authority health remains orange and the limitation is explicit.

items.name: Runtime session_id / thread_id / previous_response_id support
items.recommended_action: List as next post-freeze integration item only if 0B Gateway hardening exposes responseId, safeMemoryCandidates=[], authorityHealth.orange, and session/thread/context placeholders without claiming native semantics.
items.risk_if_deferred: Platform integration may still feel plugin-like until runtime session propagation is implemented.
items.notes: Does not block catalog-only platform stable tag if 0B fields make the known risk visible.

items.name: Gateway auth / project scope / permission proof
items.recommended_action: Confirm Gateway remains owner of login, project scope, permission proof, redaction, and platform audit.
items.risk_if_deferred: Hermes could be expected to mint or bypass permission proof.
items.notes: This is a stable safety boundary, not a new runtime feature.

items.name: Catalog-only asset query and safe refs
items.recommended_action: Keep current platform-facing capability limited to catalog-only query and safe file/model/query/trace refs.
items.risk_if_deferred: Users may infer unsupported content search from catalog metadata.
items.notes: Current stable surface is catalog-only, not evidence retrieval.

items.name: Missing Evidence for DWG/RVT/BIM/content questions
items.recommended_action: Ensure catalog-only content questions return Missing Evidence rather than unsupported claims.
items.risk_if_deferred: Hermes may appear to understand file contents from metadata only.
items.notes: This protects the stable tag from content-overclaim.

items.name: Path redaction / forbidden-field scan / fail-closed handling
items.recommended_action: Confirm raw paths, raw rows, secrets, raw answers, and unsupported evidence claims remain forbidden; high-risk forbidden-field hits should return fail-closed fallback/reason rather than only sanitized external output.
items.risk_if_deferred: Stable baseline may leak internal paths or sensitive raw fields.
items.notes: No DB/NAS smoke is required in this docs-only phase, but platform 0B hardening should close the fail-closed behavior before stable tag.

items.name: Evidence Layer / document_evidence_search
items.recommended_action: Freeze as catalog-only baseline and state governed evidence retrieval is not current runtime.
items.risk_if_deferred: Content-level answers remain unavailable and must use Missing Evidence.
items.notes: Blocks full product capability, not narrow platform stable tag.

items.name: Low-sensitive memory continuity runtime
items.recommended_action: Keep low-sensitive memory boundary as contract and defer runtime productization.
items.risk_if_deferred: Platform may not yet show full continuity beyond safe refs and query/trace concepts.
items.notes: Must not claim file content memory.

items.name: Feedback / scoring linkage
items.recommended_action: Keep feedback as review signal only; do not claim automatic metric pass or repair trigger.
items.risk_if_deferred: Feedback loop remains review-oriented rather than productized evaluation automation.
items.notes: Safe for stable tag if wording remains conservative.

items.name: Eval inventory target counts
items.recommended_action: Document as full Phase 2 metric gap; do not block narrow platform stable baseline.
items.risk_if_deferred: Cannot claim PRD 100+ or Roadmap 300+ eval closeout.
items.notes: Blocks full Phase 2 closeout, not stable platform integration.

items.name: Top5 / citation metric target-scale evidence
items.recommended_action: Keep as explicit metric gap; do not claim Top5 or citation targets.
items.risk_if_deferred: Quality claims remain unsupported at target scale.
items.notes: Scoring pack exists, but reviewed target-scale result rows are missing.

items.name: Natural language import / file governance usability
items.recommended_action: Ask user whether natural import usability must block the stable platform tag.
items.risk_if_deferred: Users may still need a separate usability phase for conversational import/governance flows.
items.notes: Recommended default is not to block platform stable tag unless user explicitly requires it.

items.name: Test-machine stable tag update
items.recommended_action: Run the test-machine update prompt only after a future stable tag is authorized.
items.risk_if_deferred: Platform may not have a reproducible stable baseline checkout.
items.notes: The placeholder tag must be replaced later; no tag is created in Phase 2.107.

items.name: Shared contract sync
items.recommended_action: Confirm shared contract remains aligned with Hermes repo wording before stable tag.
items.risk_if_deferred: Platform and Hermes may drift on kernel authority, Gateway authority, or Data Steward scope.
items.notes: No shared files were modified in Phase 2.107.

items.name: 0B Gateway hardening / compatibility-mode observability
items.recommended_action: Add responseId, safeMemoryCandidates=[], authorityHealth.orange, and session/thread/context placeholder fields without claiming native Hermes runtime semantics.
items.risk_if_deferred: Platform may ship a stable tag while hiding that current integration is still OpenAI-compatible catalog-only wrapping.
items.notes: This is Gateway wrapper hardening, not native Hermes endpoint implementation.

items.name: Forbidden-field high-risk fail-closed behavior
items.recommended_action: Upgrade high-risk forbidden-field hits to fail-closed fallback/reason instead of returning only sanitized external answers.
items.risk_if_deferred: A dangerous answer may be partially sanitized but still presented as usable Hermes output.
items.notes: Allowed safe status fields such as secretPrinted=false are not leaks; this item targets high-risk content hits.

items.name: Frontend wording for Hermes smoke / compatibility path
items.recommended_action: Replace wording that implies full native Hermes alignment, such as 真实 Hermes 回答, with safer labels such as Hermes smoke 通道回答 or 外部 Hermes catalog-only 回答 until native runtime alignment exists.
items.risk_if_deferred: Users and developers may believe the current platform path has full Hermes kernel continuity and orchestration.
items.notes: This closes product-language overclaim without changing runtime architecture.

items.name: Capabilities / health authority-health field
items.recommended_action: Expose authority_health.architecture_authority_health=orange in health/capabilities until Hermes native session/thread/response lifecycle is integrated.
items.risk_if_deferred: Integration health may be misread as green even though architecture authority remains partially plugin-like.
items.notes: This is an honesty and observability field; it does not block catalog-only use.

items.name: Production rollout
items.recommended_action: Keep production rollout out of Phase 2 stable platform baseline.
items.risk_if_deferred: No risk to narrow stable tag; production readiness remains a later workstream.
items.notes: Stable platform integration baseline is not rollout.

items.name: Data Steward full productization
items.recommended_action: Keep Data Steward product line, graph/spatial, and BIM content understanding after stable baseline.
items.risk_if_deferred: Data Steward remains a catalog capability module, not the full Hermes product.
items.notes: Do not imply BIM/DWG/RVT content understanding is current.

items.name: Agent DB CRUD / SQL
items.recommended_action: Keep Agent SQL/CRUD out of stable platform baseline.
items.risk_if_deferred: No risk to catalog-only stable tag; DB write/read authority remains with platform/Gateway systems.
items.notes: Hermes must not naked-connect to DB or generate SQL.

items.name: NAS semantic collection
items.recommended_action: Defer NAS semantic indexing and unrestricted NAS scan/copy to later phases.
items.risk_if_deferred: Content-level NAS questions remain Missing Evidence or manual review.
items.notes: Stable baseline keeps catalog-only boundary.
